lines.x: Brazil's central bank conducted its first reserve auction since late 2024, selling $1 billion to curb currency weakness.
Brazilian equities fell 1.3% while the real weakened to 5.88 against the US dollar ahead of the B3 open.
Goldman Sachs downgraded Brazilian equities to neutral, noting limited room for rate cuts while the central bank maintains the Selic rate at 13.75%.
The Brazilian real held near 5.78 per US dollar as traders weighed domestic Selic rate expectations and upcoming congressional deliberations on fiscal policy measures.
